Killing an Exhausted or <strand Severed /> enemy with a Weapon matching your Super's element grants additional Super Ability Energy based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Rank-and-File: 3.56%
• Elites: 4.4%
• Minibosses and above: 7%
• Guardians: 7%?

Does not trigger with Sword Kills.

On Exhausted or Severed Enemy Kill with Super-Matching Weapons:

Grants Additional Super Ability Energy.
RnF = 3.56% | Elite = 4.4% | Miniboss+ = 7% | Guardian = 7%?

Does not trigger with Sword Kills.
